description.zh-TW: 用一段模板拼出自己的卡片，例如 CPU {cpu}% · {time}
description.zh-CN: 用一段模板拼出自己的卡片，例如 CPU {cpu}% · {time}
description.en: Build your own card from a template, e.g. CPU {cpu}% · {time}

description.zh-TW: # 開頭是大標題，## 是小標題，--- 是分隔線。可用：{time} {seconds} {date} {weekday} {year} {month} {day} {cpu} {mem} {memUsed} {memTotal} {down} {up} {disk} {disk:D} {battery}
description.zh-CN: # 开头是大标题，## 是小标题，--- 是分隔线。可用：{time} {seconds} {date} {weekday} {year} {month} {day} {cpu} {mem} {memUsed} {memTotal} {down} {up} {disk} {disk:D} {battery}
description.en: # for a big line, ## for a heading, --- for a rule. Tokens: {time} {seconds} {date} {weekday} {year} {month} {day} {cpu} {mem} {memUsed} {memTotal} {down} {up} {disk} {disk:D} {battery}
